# ART-GENERATION-0, the first brief: "a rain-soaked brutalist coastal plaza at night", dressed on the tactical
# graybox. The art direction is the model's; nothing here moves a wall, a floor, a cover block or a spawn — those are
# the admitted layout's and the graybox map's. Colours are R,G,B 0-255 (sRGB), lengths metres, light in lux or
# candelas. The direction, in one breath: monumental raw concrete under a low sea fog, everything wet; warm sodium on
# the lanes, cold moonlight from the sea to the south-west; the plaza ringed by stepped towers and a cantilevered
# slab; team colours in the neon — amber at base A in the west, cyan at base B in the east, magenta where they meet.

map tactical
title Rain-soaked brutalist coastal plaza at night
seed tidewater

time night
moon 215 24 0.35 168,186,255
fog 0.045 38,54,74 volumetric
exposure 1.5
bloom 0.9
rain 0.8

# every mesh names where it came from and under what licence
asset cube /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube.Cube engine Unreal Engine EULA (engine content)

# the palette: raw and wet concrete, black-water puddles, dark steel housings, three neons

material concrete_wet    74,74,76   0.30 0.0
material floor_wet       46,47,50   0.16 0.0

surface wall   concrete

# lanes; oil standing on the paving; signal red at the bases. Made only of statements the language has (FACADE-0's

# the long brick one at the north lane's west end, building:10,2-17,2.
